records.label: Files linked to the task in Salesforce

observations: Two copies on purpose, and not reconciled. Salesforce’s copy makes preview and download work with no round trip; ServiceNow’s is the copy an auditor is entitled to and the only one the attestation gate counts.
expected: The panel lists Salesforce files and ServiceNow attachments separately.
A failed push is therefore visible rather than inferred.
actual: Panel shows two separate columns: "Salesforce Files" (1) and "ServiceNow attachments" (2).
